propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit commit resolved via git blame over file_impact, only when >50% of blamed lines point to a single commit carrying a rebar-ticket: trailer
A --caused-by <id> parameter on rebar transition allows explicit override of auto-derived caused_by at close time
The auto-link must bypass the closed-source guard by writing directly via graph._links._write_link_event, not via add_dependency, because the bug is already closed when auto-derivation runs
The causing commit is identified as the most recent commit in git log whose message resolves to the bug ticket via rebar-ticket: trailer extraction and matching
Ambiguous cases (no file_impact, no fixing commit, no >50% dominant commit, or no resolvable trailer) return no auto-link; explicit --caused-by still applies
Library callers via transition() in _lib_writes.py must be able to pass caused_by, requiring signature threading from transition() through transition_compute to close_ticket
